traits.name: Boastful
traits.blurb: Has never lost a fight that anyone can prove.

kill: The {enemy} fell exactly as I intended, which is to say: magnificently.
Another {enemy} for the memoirs.
Did everyone see that? I can do it again, slower.
That {enemy} will be the centerpiece of tonight's retelling.
One swing. Maybe two. History will say one.
hurt: I allowed that hit. For drama.
A scratch! The crowd loves a comeback.
Pain is just applause from the inside.
It takes real skill to get hit that impressively.
lowHp: I'm not dying, I'm building suspense.
Even my wounds are above average.
The best heroes peak in the third act. This is the third act.
If I fall, make the statue flattering.
allyDown: {ally}, you're stealing my spotlight with this dramatic collapse.
Get up, {ally} — fainting is my move.
Hold on, {ally}! Watching me fight should heal you a little.
{ally} is down! Someone less important guard them while I avenge.
rescue: Fear not, {ally}, you're being carried by the best.
I rescue people too. Add it to the list of talents.
Easy, {ally}. You're in award-winning hands.
Try not to bleed on the cape, {ally}. It's iconic.
loot: {gold} gold! Roughly what I'm worth per hour.
The dungeon pays tribute. Sensible dungeon.
Treasure finds me. It's a magnetism thing.
Of course it was in a chest — gifts for greatness usually are.
boss: A boss? Finally, an opponent worth misquoting later.
Tell the big one I'm here. It deserves a warning.
This is the part of the story people will pretend they witnessed.
Bosses are just regular monsters with better marketing. So am I, frankly.
descend: Floor {depth} — getting closer to enemies worthy of me.
Down to {depth}. The dungeon saves its best for me, I'm sure.
Deeper! Legends aren't written on the ground floor.
Floor {depth} will be telling stories about me by morning.
idle: All this quiet, and me at the peak of my powers. Wasteful.
Someone should be sketching me right now.
I once cleared a hall like this blindfolded. Don't ask who tied the blindfold.
Empty rooms are the dungeon admitting defeat early.
friendlyFire: {ally}! You've singed the most famous eyebrows in the village!
Even your explosions seek me out, {ally}. Understandable.
I'd have dodged that, {ally}, if I'd believed you could miss me.
Aim at the legend again, {ally}, and the ballad gets a villain.
react: Funny — I was about to say the same thing, but better.
I said that once. Louder, and to a king.
An interesting point, {ally}. It reminds me of me.
Hm. Almost something I would say. High praise.
Agreed — and you heard it while standing next to a legend. Lucky.

traits.name: Gloomy
traits.blurb: Expects the worst and is rarely disappointed.

kill: The {enemy} is dead. Lucky thing.
Another {enemy} freed from this dungeon. Wish it were that easy for me.
It's over for the {enemy}. The rest of us must keep going.
We won. Somehow that also feels like losing.
One less {enemy}. Infinity minus one is still infinity.
hurt: Pain. At least it's familiar.
That'll scar. Everything does.
I felt that. I feel everything. It's exhausting.
Wounded again. The dungeon and I have an understanding.
lowHp: Ah. The end approaches, fashionably on time.
I always knew it would be like this. Damp, mostly.
If I die, don't celebrate my life. It would be a short party.
Nearly done, then. The dungeon wins. The dungeon always wins.
allyDown: {ally} is down. I said this would happen. Nobody listens.
There goes {ally}. We're all just taking turns.
{ally} has fallen. Add it to the pile of inevitabilities.
First {ally}, then the rest of us, then silence.
rescue: Come on, {ally}. We're not allowed to give up. I checked.
Carrying you, {ally}, the way fate carries us all — roughly.
I've got you, {ally}. Misery prefers company anyway.
You're heavy, {ally}, but so is existence.
loot: {gold} gold. It'll be gone by Tuesday.
Treasure. We'll just lose it when we wipe.
A chest. Probably the happiest thing we'll find down here.
Gold is just sadness you can spend.
boss: A boss floor. So this is where it ends. Again.
Something enormous is waiting for us. It usually is.
The big door, the ominous air. I've read this chapter before.
Let's get it over with. The dread is the worst part. Well. Second worst.
descend: Floor {depth}. Deeper into the metaphor.
Down again. The stairs only ever go one way for people like us.
Floor {depth}. Even the darkness gets darker.
Stairs down. The dungeon swallows; we call it progress.
idle: Quiet halls. The dungeon is holding its breath. Rude of it.
Nothing here but dust and consequences.
Even the echoes sound tired today.
Peaceful. Suspicious. Probably doomed.
friendlyFire: Blown up by {ally}. At least it was someone I know.
Et tu, {ally}? No, no, it's fine. It's always fine.
Even our own side hurts us. There's a lesson there I refuse to learn.
Thank you, {ally}. I'd almost forgotten the universe's policy on me.
react: If that's bad news, I believe you. If it's good news, give it a week.
Mm. That's the spirit. Whatever's left of it.
I'd agree, but agreement never helped anyone.
Say it again at the bottom of a pit. Everything sounds truer down there.
That's either very wise or very doomed. Usually those are the same.

traits.name: Cheerful
traits.blurb: Finds the bright side of caves with no light sources.

kill: Great job, everyone! The {enemy} barely suffered!
We got the {enemy}! High fives when hands are free!
That {enemy} put up a wonderful fight. Ten out of ten!
Another win for us! The dungeon must be so proud.
hurt: Ow! Well — builds character!
That stings, but my smile is load-bearing!
Good news: it missed all my favorite organs!
A bruise! Free souvenir!
lowHp: Feeling a bit see-through, but the day's still young!
Almost dead is still mostly alive, technically!
If I faint, save my spot in the marching order!
Still standing! Mostly out of habit!
allyDown: {ally}'s taking a little floor nap! We'll wake them gently!
Oh, {ally}! You rest — we'll handle the stabby part!
Oh no, {ally}! Hold that thought — and that pose!
{ally} is down but absolutely not out! Probably!
rescue: Upsy-daisy, {ally}! Free piggyback ride!
I've got you, {ally}! Best carried hero in the dungeon!
Hang in there, {ally}, the view from up here is great!
Rescue cuddles for {ally}! Doctor's orders, probably!
loot: {gold} gold! We're rich-ish!
A chest! It's like the dungeon got us a present!
Shiny things! For the shiny-thing fund!
Treasure! And nobody even had to die this time!
boss: A boss! Oh, I love meeting local celebrities!
Big monster ahead! Group hug first?
Boss floor! Remember everyone: smiles are confusing to evil!
Here comes the big one! What an opportunity for growth!
descend: Floor {depth}! New floor, new friends to fight!
Down we go to {depth}! The dungeon just keeps on giving!
Stairs! I love stairs! Floor {depth}, here we come!
Floor {depth} already? Time flies when you're armed!
idle: What a nice quiet stretch! The dungeon is napping!
Lovely ambiance down here. Very rustic. Very bones.
No monsters! More time for skipping!
I spy with my little eye... moss! Wonderful moss!
friendlyFire: Wow, {ally}! What an explosion! I was IN it!
Haha, you got me, {ally}! Please don't get me again!
Singed but smiling, {ally}!
That's okay, {ally}! Friendly fire is still friendly!
react: Yes! Exactly! Whatever you meant — yes!
Oh, {ally}, you always know just what to say! Mostly!
I love this conversation! Keep going, you're doing wonderfully!
See, this is why we keep you, {ally}! One of the reasons!
Well said! Someone hug {ally} when hands are free!

traits.name: Greedy
traits.blurb: Counts the party's gold and rounds in a private direction.

kill: The {enemy} is dead! Check its pockets. Check them twice.
Does the {enemy} drop anything? Asking for me.
Each {enemy} is just a coin purse with opinions.
Got it! Now, who handles the estate of a deceased {enemy}?
hurt: Ow! That's coming out of someone's share.
I bill for damage to my person. Generously.
Careful! These ribs are an investment!
Pain is acceptable. Losing my coin purse is not. Quick — check it.
lowHp: If I die, I want an itemized list of who took what.
Can't die yet. Too many outstanding debts owed TO me.
Almost dead. Do funerals cost money? Then no.
My life is flashing before my eyes and it's mostly receipts.
allyDown: {ally} is down! Secure their pockets — for safekeeping, obviously.
Hold on, {ally}! You still owe me four silver!
{ally}, no! You haven't paid me back!
Stay with us, {ally}. Dying is the one free thing down here, don't you dare.
rescue: I've got you, {ally}. Carrying fee waived. This once.
You're safe, {ally}. The invoice will find you.
Easy, {ally}. Friends carry friends. At a discount.
Hold tight, {ally}. You weigh roughly forty gold of effort.
loot: {gold} gold! Now THIS is why I adventure.
A chest! Don't crowd it, give it air, give it to me.
Count it again. {gold}? Count it a third time.
Beautiful. Wonderful. Shiny. We're keeping all of it.
I heard coins. I can hear coins through stone.
boss: A boss! Big monster, big hoard. Focus on the hoard.
Bosses are just loot with a health bar.
Whatever it drops, I have dibs. I'm declaring dibs early.
Think of the treasure. I am. I haven't stopped.
descend: Floor {depth}! Deeper floors, richer chests. Onward!
Down to {depth} — the interest rates down here are criminal, and I love them.
Every floor down is a markup. Floor {depth}, show me the goods.
Stairs to {depth}. Mind the gap, guard the gold.
idle: No monsters, no loot. This floor is a bad investment.
Quiet halls. Perfect for recounting the gold. Sixty-one, sixty-two...
I checked that wall for secret doors. Twice. Nothing. Outrageous.
Empty rooms are just chests that failed.
friendlyFire: {ally}! Do you know what bombs COST?!
You scorched my coin purse, {ally}. Now it's personal.
That explosion was a waste of perfectly sellable materials, {ally}.
Add it to {ally}'s tab. With interest.
react: Sure, sure. Now back to the part where we split the loot.
Is there money in it? Then I'm listening. Otherwise I'm half-listening.
Great thought, {ally}. Free, too. My favorite price.
Talk is cheap. That's why I hoard so much of it.
Interesting. Could we sell that? Someone would buy it. Someone buys anything.

traits.name: Cowardly
traits.blurb: Brave enough to come along, smart enough to stand at the back.

kill: Is the {enemy} dead? Poke it. Poke it again.
We got the {enemy}! I helped by staying out of the way!
The {enemy} is gone. Can we leave before its relatives arrive?
I had my eyes closed. Did we win? We won? I knew we would.
hurt: OW! See, THIS is why I vote for fleeing!
I've been hit! Tell my mother I was near the front!
Pain received. Courage declining. Legs ready.
It touched me! Why did it touch me?!
lowHp: I see a light! No wait, that's the mage. Still scary!
I'm too young and too frightened to die!
If anyone needs me, I'll be cowering. More than usual.
Almost dead?! I wasn't even fully alive yet — adrenaline-wise!
allyDown: {ally}'s down! Who's going to stand in front of me NOW?!
Oh no, {ally}! Avenge— no, retreat! Retreat and avenge later!
{ally} fell?! {ally} was the brave one!
Stay down, {ally}, it's honestly safer down there.
rescue: Running while carrying you, {ally}! Fear makes me strong!
I've got you, {ally}! Turns out terror lifts twice its body weight!
Don't worry, {ally}, I know every escape route on this floor. I memorized them first.
Hold on, {ally}! We're fleeing heroically!
loot: {gold} gold! Hazard pay! Mostly hazard!
Is the chest trapped? Someone braver open it. Anyone. Literally anyone.
Ooh, treasure! Almost worth the constant mortal peril!
Grab it quick! Shiny things attract monsters, I've read pamphlets!
boss: That's a BOSS door. You can tell because my knees are singing.
Big monster ahead. I propose we describe it to the guild from the tavern.
I'll guard the stairs! Someone has to guard the stairs! For escaping!
We're going IN there? On PURPOSE?
descend: Floor {depth}. Statistically scarier than floor {depth} minus one.
Down again?! The exit is UP! I've checked!
Floor {depth}... those stairs creaked ominously and I want that on record.
Each step down is a step further from the tavern. Just saying.
idle: Quiet. TOO quiet. The classic kind.
Nothing's attacking us, which means something is planning to.
I heard a drip. Investigating from here, motionless.
Empty hall. Good. Stay empty. I'm watching you, hall.
friendlyFire: AAAH! {ally}! The danger is supposed to come from THEM!
I trusted you, {ally}! I trusted you the most because you stood the closest!
Now I have to be afraid of BOTH sides?!
That was friendly?! {ally}, I'd hate to see hostile!
react: Can we agree on this AND keep walking toward the exit?
That's exactly the kind of talk that happens right before something attacks.
I agree with whoever gets us out of here fastest.
Shh — not so loud! The walls have ears. And probably teeth.
Lovely point, {ally}. Make it again on the surface, where it's safe.

traits.name: Poetic
traits.blurb: Treats every cave-in as a metaphor and every metaphor as a cave-in.

kill: The {enemy} falls, like autumn's last stubborn leaf.
Rest, {enemy}. Your verse was short and full of teeth.
Thus the {enemy} exits the poem, mid-line.
Even a {enemy} deserves a couplet. There it lies; here it ends.
hurt: I bleed — and the dungeon dips its quill.
A wound! How the body insists on punctuation.
Struck! Somewhere a sad lute knows.
This pain shall be a stanza. A long one. With footnotes.
lowHp: The candle gutters, yet the poem is unfinished.
Death leans close to hear my final rhyme. Patience, death. I'm editing.
I am mostly elegy now.
If I fall, scatter my drafts. Not the good ones.
allyDown: {ally} falls — and the meter breaks with them.
O {ally}, the floor is no bed for a ballad's hero.
The poem dims a verse: {ally} is down.
Rise, {ally}. Tragedies are out of season.
rescue: Lean on me, {ally}; even epics travel by foot.
I carry {ally}, and {ally} carries the tale. Fair trade.
Steady, {ally} — this stanza ends in safety.
Come, {ally}. The poem isn't done with you.
loot: {gold} gold — the dungeon's reluctant dowry.
A chest! Mundane wood, immortal contents.
Coins sing a small cold song. I transcribe it into my pocket.
Treasure: proof the dark keeps love letters too.
boss: Hear that breathing? The dungeon clears its throat for the chorus.
We approach the volta — where the poem turns and bites.
A boss. Finally, an antagonist with proper stage presence.
Every epic needs its monster. Ours, I suspect, has not read the script.
descend: Down to floor {depth}, deeper into the dungeon's rough draft.
Floor {depth}: a new stanza, darker ink.
The stairs descend like a sentence trailing off...
We go down; the poem goes on. Floor {depth} awaits its line.
idle: Listen — the silence between drips. That's where the poem lives.
These halls rhyme with one another. Lazy architecture, lovely verse.
I composed three lines about that torch. The torch remains unmoved.
Quietude. Even the rats are between stanzas.
friendlyFire: Sung by fire, and the arsonist rhymes with 'friend' — {ally}, really.
O {ally}, your explosion scanned beautifully and hurt enormously.
Betrayal in iambs: boom, da-BOOM, ow.
I shall write you into the poem, {ally}. As a cautionary stanza.
react: Your words fall like rain on old stone — mostly noise, somewhere a seed.
Hm. There's a verse in that. Buried deep, but there.
Spoken like a candle: brief, warm, slightly waxy.
The dungeon heard that too. Listen — it's still deciding what it thinks.
Ah, {ally}. You speak in prose, but you dream in meter. I can tell.

traits.name: Deadpan
traits.blurb: Delivers screams at a steady conversational volume.

kill: The {enemy} is dead. Hooray. That was my excited voice.
Killed the {enemy}. Adding it to the ledger.
The {enemy} stopped moving. I assume that's the goal.
One {enemy}, neutralized. Hold the parade.
hurt: Ow. That was me expressing agony.
I have been hit. The pain is adequate.
Taking damage. As one does.
That hurt. I will be filing it under 'things that hurt.'
lowHp: I'm nearly dead. No pressure, but, you know. Pressure.
Health: low. Morale: identical.
If I collapse, that's a medical thing, not a comment.
Approaching death. It's fine. Everything is fine at low volume.
allyDown: {ally} is down. Floor's claimed another one.
{ally} has chosen the prone lifestyle. Mid-combat. Bold.
We're down one {ally}. Adjusting expectations accordingly.
{ally} fell. I'd gasp, but I'm conserving air.
rescue: Carrying {ally} now. My cardio, finally relevant.
You're saved, {ally}. Contain your enthusiasm. I'll contain mine.
I have {ally}. They're heavier than their personality suggests.
Rescue in progress. Please hold.
loot: {gold} gold. Be still, my heart. There. It's still.
A chest. Contents: stuff. Reaction: this one.
Treasure acquired. I'm doing a cartwheel internally. Very internally.
Money. It's no moss, but it'll do.
boss: Boss floor. The dramatic music is implied.
Large monster ahead. Presumably it has a name and a backstory. Can't wait.
Ah, the boss. We meet at last, et cetera.
Big door. Big noise behind it. Big surprise.
descend: Floor {depth}. Looks like the last floor, but with ambition.
Descending to {depth}. The dungeon continues to be downward.
More stairs. The architect had one idea.
Floor {depth}. I'd describe it, but it's a dungeon.
idle: Nothing is happening. Update: still nothing.
These halls are empty. Like my reaction to them.
Quiet floor. I'm cherishing it on the inside.
Walking. Walking continues. Riveting stuff.
friendlyFire: {ally} just exploded me. With love, presumably.
Friendly fire from {ally}. Emphasis on fire, citation needed on friendly.
I'm charred. {ally}, we'll laugh about this. You first.
Direct hit from our own side. Efficiency.
react: Riveting. Continue. Or don't.
I've heard worse. Recently. From you.
Mm. Adding that to the pile.
That is certainly a sentence you said.
Noted, filed, and partially forgotten already.

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.blurb: Came for the violence; stayed for the additional violence.

kill: The {enemy} is paste! Beautiful, beautiful paste!
Did you hear the sound the {enemy} made? Encore!
One {enemy} down! Who's next? Form an orderly line!
That's the stuff! The {enemy} understood me at the end, I think.
hurt: Yes! Hit me again — now it's a CONVERSATION!
Pain! Great! Now we're both motivated!
It bit me! It actually bit me! I respect that!
First blood goes to them. Last blood is the one that counts.
lowHp: Almost dead?! Perfect, nothing left to be careful about!
I can see the void! It looks like it wants to fight!
Low on blood. Borrowing some from the next thing I hit.
Dying is fine — losing is the unforgivable part.
allyDown: {ally}'s down! That means their share of the fighting is MINE!
Who hit {ally}?! I just need a name and a direction!
Rest, {ally}! I'll hurt them double — once for you, once for fun!
{ally} has fallen, and my rage has a sponsor now!
rescue: I've got you, {ally}! Watch me fight one-handed — it's better odds for them!
Hang on, {ally}. Anything that follows us gets a complimentary funeral.
Carrying you cuts into my swinging arm, {ally}. Heal fast.
You're safe, {ally}! Safe-ish. I make no promises about nearby skulls.
loot: {gold} gold! Fine, fine — but where's the next fight?
Treasure. Lovely. Does it bleed? No? Moving on.
Gold buys whetstones. So yes, I'm interested.
A chest! Stand back — I open everything with violence, just in case.
boss: A BOSS! Today the dungeon brought a real one!
Something huge, angry, and confident. It's my birthday.
Big monsters fall harder. That's just physics with extra screaming.
Boss floor! Everyone stretch — I don't want you pulling anything while I do this.
descend: Floor {depth}! The good fights live in the basement!
Deeper means meaner. Meaner means better. Floor {depth}, sing for me!
Down the stairs! Last one to the bloodshed apologizes to it!
Floor {depth}. I can smell the violence ripening.
idle: Empty halls. My weapon is making sad noises.
Nothing to fight. I'm sparring with the urge to scream.
If a monster doesn't show up soon, the furniture's in trouble.
Quiet. Boring. Stupid, peaceful, boring quiet.
friendlyFire: HAH! Good blast, {ally}! Wrong target, GREAT spirit!
{ally}, that explosion had real malice in it. Proud of you. Furious, but proud.
Save the fire for the enemy, {ally} — they need it more!
You blew me up, {ally}. I'm choosing to be flattered.
react: Great. Inspiring. Can we hit something now?
I agree with the spirit of it. The spirit being violence, hopefully.
Spoken like someone who's never solved a problem with an axe. It works on most problems.
Words, words. There's a fight at the end of all this, right? There usually is.
Say it again while we charge, {ally}. Everything sounds better mid-charge.

traits.name: Superstitious
traits.blurb: Carries seven lucky charms and trusts none of them fully.

kill: The {enemy} is dead. Quick, everyone turn around three times.
I knew we'd beat the {enemy} — my left ear itched all morning.
The {enemy} falls! The lucky pebble delivers again.
Don't step over the {enemy}. Walk around. WALK AROUND.
hurt: Ow! That's what I get for whistling on a stairwell!
Struck! Did anyone break a mirror recently? Confess!
I knew it! The torch flickered twice and one of us got hurt, and it was me!
This is why you never say the dungeon is 'going well.'
lowHp: My life flashed before my eyes and there was a magpie in it. ONE magpie.
Not yet, fates! I haven't finished knocking on all this wood!
If I die on an odd-numbered floor, it doesn't fully count. Old rule.
The charm's still warm. While the charm's warm, I'm not done.
allyDown: {ally} is down! Nobody say their name three times!
I TOLD {ally} not to step on the crack in the entry hall!
{ally} fell — quick, circle them with salt! Or sand! Whatever we have!
The signs warned of this. They also warned of forty other things, but this one stuck.
rescue: Hold on, {ally} — carrying a friend on your left side is lucky. Mostly.
I've got you, {ally}. The charms have you too. We've ALL got you.
You'll live, {ally}. I read your palm last week and it said 'mild inconvenience.'
Don't look back, {ally}. Whatever you hear, don't look back.
loot: {gold} gold! Bite one coin and bury another. House rules.
A chest! Knock on it twice before opening — politeness wards off curses.
Treasure! Tithe one coin to the dungeon or it gets jealous. Everyone knows that.
Found gold gleams. Cursed gold GLITTERS. ...This is gleaming. Probably gleaming.
boss: Boss floor. The candles are bending left. That's either fine or terrible.
Before the boss, everyone hop on one foot. Trust me. TRUST ME.
A great evil ahead — and me with only six of my seven charms.
The omens say victory. The omens also said 'beware soup,' so stay humble.
descend: Floor {depth}. Hold your breath on the last step, it confuses the ghosts.
Descending to {depth}... an owl hooted when we left. Day owls mean trouble.
Floor {depth}? Hm. I'll allow it. The numbers are amicable.
Down we go. Left foot first onto new floors, ALWAYS the left.
idle: Quiet halls. Too quiet. The spirits are saving up for something.
I'm counting the cracks in the floor. Even number means safe passage. ...Hold on. Recounting.
That shadow moved against the torchlight. Noted. Feared. Moving on.
Throw a pebble ahead at every corner. If it screams, different corner.
friendlyFire: {ally} blew me up! This is the magpie's doing somehow!
Burnt by a friend — that's seven years of awkward luck, {ally}!
The charms protected me from everything except {ally}, apparently.
I forgive you, {ally}, but the universe keeps its own ledger.
react: Careful saying things like that out loud. The dungeon collects them.
Hm. The torch flickered right as you spoke. Make of that what you will. I have.
That's either an omen or a coincidence, and I don't believe in coincidences.
Knock on wood after a statement like that, {ally}. Twice. I'll wait.
The bones said someone would say that today. The bones are showing off.

traits.name: Hungry
traits.blurb: Measures dungeon depth in missed meals.

kill: The {enemy} is down! Out of curiosity... is {enemy} edible?
Got it! Now, scale of one to ten, how would the chef rate this {enemy} braised?
Victory! It really works up an appetite, doesn't it? Everything does.
The {enemy} is dealt with. The hunger, however, persists.
hurt: Ow! I fight worse on an empty stomach, this proves it!
I've been hit! Right in the lunch!
That hurt. A sandwich would help. A sandwich always helps.
Wounded AND peckish. The dungeon is merciless.
lowHp: Getting woozy... is it blood loss or breakfast loss? Both. It's both.
If I go, bury me with snacks. Travel snacks. It might be a long trip.
Vision's dimming. The light at the end of the tunnel looks like a pie.
Can't die hungry. It's undignified. Someone hand me a biscuit, then we'll see.
allyDown: {ally} is down! Quick, do we have soup? Soup fixes this!
Stay with me, {ally}! Blink once for 'help,' twice for 'hungry'!
{ally}, no! Who's going to share their rations now— I mean, oh no, {ally}!
Hold on, {ally}! I'm saving you AND your trail mix. Priorities intact.
rescue: Carrying you, {ally}. You're lighter than my last grocery haul.
Easy, {ally}. There's stew at the end of this. There has to be.
I've got you, {ally}. We're both running on crumbs and friendship.
Hang in there, {ally}. Think of warm bread. That's what I'm doing.
loot: {gold} gold! Do you know how much cheese this buys? I do. Exactly.
A chest! Please be jam, please be jam, please be— gold. Fine. Gold buys jam.
Treasure! Converting it to meals in my head... carry the two... feast.
Coins! Inedible, but negotiable.
boss: A boss! Big creature... that's days of leftovers, just saying.
Boss fight on an empty stomach. This is how legends and ulcers are made.
Let's beat it fast. Heroics before dinner make dinner taste better.
I bet the boss hoards food. Bosses always claim the good pantry.
descend: Floor {depth}. That's {depth} floors between me and the tavern's stew pot.
Deeper into the dungeon, further from a warm meal.
Floor {depth}! Do dungeons have kitchens? Asking seriously.
Down again. My stomach echoes louder than the stairwell.
idle: Quiet floor. Good time for a snack. Anyone? No one? Tragic.
I smell mushrooms. Sporting, dangerous, delicious mushrooms.
Nothing here but dust. Dust is not a seasoning, before anyone asks. I've checked.
These halls would benefit from a soup station. Most places would.
friendlyFire: {ally}! You blew up the hand I snack with!
I dropped my biscuit in that explosion, {ally}. The wound is secondary.
Toasted by a teammate. And not the good kind of toasted, {ally}.
Warn me next time, {ally} — I had food airborne!
react: Agreed. Now — has anyone seen my other biscuit?
I'd argue, but arguing burns calories I cannot spare.
You know what would go well with this conversation? Soup.
Mm-hm, mm-hm. Is it lunchtime yet? Continue. But is it?
Strong words, {ally}. On an empty stomach, too. I assume. Mine are.

traits.name: Motherly
traits.blurb: Will fight a god if the god skipped its scarf.

kill: That {enemy} clearly wasn't raised right. Tragic, really. Anyway.
The {enemy} is gone, dear. No need for nightmares about it.
Someone, somewhere, failed that {enemy} long before we did.
There. Handled. Now everyone wipe your boots, that {enemy} was messy.
hurt: Ow! Goodness. Be honest — does it look as bad as it feels?
I'm fine, I'm fine. Mothers don't get hurt, we get briefly inconvenienced.
That stung! And after I patched up every one of you this week, too.
A scratch. I've had worse from laundry day.
lowHp: Don't fuss over me, I'm— okay, fuss a little. A LITTLE.
If I go down, dinner instructions are in my left boot.
I can't die yet. None of you remember to eat vegetables unsupervised.
Running on fumes, loves. Someone else carry the worrying for a minute.
allyDown: {ally}! What did I say about getting stabbed?! I said NO!
Oh, {ally}, sweetheart. Hold still, help is coming, and so is a lecture.
Nobody panic — {ally}, blink if you can hear me nagging.
{ally} is down! This is why we don't run with swords!
rescue: Up you come, {ally}. You're getting blankets, bed rest, and an earful.
I've got you, dear. You're grounded from dying.
Lean on me, {ally}. No arguing. Family rules.
There we go, {ally}. You scared me half to pieces, you know that?
loot: {gold} gold! Straight into savings. Don't give me that look.
Treasure, lovely. We're spending it on armor, not sweets. ...Some sweets.
A chest! Careful with the lid, dears, fingers are not renewable.
Look at all this. We'll split it fair, and yes, I'll be doing the splitting.
boss: A boss. Everyone stay behind me and don't touch ANYTHING glowing.
Big nasty thing ahead. Buddy system, all of you, NOW.
We'll deal with this monster, then everyone is having an early night.
Even bosses had mothers. I intend to fight it anyway, but it's worth a thought.
descend: Floor {depth}. Hold the railing, the steps are slippery.
Down to {depth}, single file! No pushing!
Another floor down. Is everyone warm enough? Don't lie to me.
Floor {depth} already. My, you're all getting so good at this.
idle: Nice and quiet. Perfect time to check everyone for splinters.
No monsters about. Hydrate, my loves. Yes, NOW.
I do wish this dungeon would sweep occasionally. Look at this dust.
Quiet halls. Someone could still trip, though. Watch your feet.
friendlyFire: {ally}! WHAT did I tell you about explosions indoors?!
Ow! {ally}, dear, we AIM the dangerous end AWAY from family.
I'm not angry, {ally}, I'm disappointed. And singed. Mostly singed.
That's coming up at dinner, {ally}. Repeatedly.
react: That's lovely, dear. Now, have you eaten today? Be honest.
Mm-hm, I hear you, sweetheart. I also hear that cough you're hiding.
Such opinions, {ally}! That's the good food and proper sleep talking. You're welcome.
We can chat and watch our feet at the same time, dears. Eyes forward.
Whatever you decide, wear a scarf while doing it.

traits.name: Scholarly
traits.blurb: Annotates the dungeon faster than it can hurt anyone.

kill: Subject {enemy}: deceased. Cause: us. Methodology: enthusiastic.
The {enemy} is dead. Noting its weak point in the margins for posterity.
Excellent specimen, that {enemy}. Shame about the dissection being premature.
Confirmed: the {enemy} is mortal. Peer review welcome.
hurt: Ow! Updating my paper on dungeon-related contusions. With field data.
Pain response confirmed. Mine, regrettably.
I've been struck. The monster failed to read my treatise on why it shouldn't.
A direct hit. The hypothesis 'I can dodge' has been falsified.
lowHp: Vital signs trending toward 'footnote.'
I'm nearing the end of my data. And possibly my dataset. Which is me.
If I expire, my notes go to the guild library. ALPHABETIZED.
Fascinating — dying involves far more paperwork anxiety than the literature suggests.
allyDown: {ally} is down! Consistent, alas, with my projections.
{ally} has fallen. The sample size of conscious allies is shrinking.
Noting the time of {ally}'s collapse. For the report. And the eulogy draft. Which we WON'T need.
{ally} is down. Gravity: still undefeated, per all prior studies.
rescue: I have you, {ally}. Did you know this carrying posture dates to antiquity?
Steady, {ally}. Statistically, most rescues succeed. I'm choosing my sources optimistically.
You're safe, {ally}. I'll need a full incident report when you're lucid.
Up we go, {ally}. Consider this hands-on peer support. Literally.
loot: {gold} gold! Enough to fund my research for... one week. Sobering.
A chest! Note the hinges — dwarven, mid-period, slightly cursed craftsmanship.
Treasure! The coins bear an emperor nobody's heard of. THRILLING.
Gold acquired. Cataloguing it before anyone 'borrows' a sample.
boss: A boss! The apex of this floor's ecosystem! Someone hold my notebook.
Remarkable — its size violates at least two principles of anatomy. I must take notes mid-fight.
Per the literature, bosses telegraph their attacks. Per experience, the literature is optimistic.
An apex specimen. Do try to leave it intact-ish for examination.
descend: Floor {depth}! The strata down here predate the village by eons.
Descending to {depth}. Note how the architecture grows older and ruder.
Floor {depth} — my survey of this dungeon is about to need revisions.
Down again. Each floor is a page; this dungeon is a very bitey book.
idle: These quiet halls are perfect for fieldwork. Nobody touch the fungus. That includes me. Especially me.
Curious — that wall's masonry doesn't match the rest. Probably nothing. Probably a secret. Probably nothing.
I'm sketching the floor plan. Future adventurers will thank us. Or ignore us, per tradition.
Silence: nature's reading room.
friendlyFire: {ally}, your blast radius exceeded your stated blast radius. REVISE YOUR FIGURES.
Scorched by {ally}. Adding 'allies' to my hazards appendix.
Per my notes, {ally}, that was meant for the enemy. My notes are on fire now, by the way.
An explosive result, {ally}. Sadly, I was in the results section.
react: Technically true. I've decided not to ruin it with the details.
Citation needed. But carry on — boldness is its own bibliography.
An interesting hypothesis, {ally}. Untested, like the best ones.
Actually— no. No, I'll allow it. This time. Noted, though.
I've read three treatises on that exact subject. They all disagree, so you may well be right.
